task.title: To Add Fields to your App

context.p: After at least one Object has been added to your Data Migration app, you can add fields for each selected Object.

step.cmd: From the Data Migration Wizard screen, click on the link under the Fields column corresponding to the Object you want to work with.
Select the check box for each field you want to add to your app. To refine the list of fields, enter text into the Search field. Note: You cannot deselect the Object fields ID or Name.
Click Apply to add fields to your app for the selected Object.
Repeat steps 1 – 3 for each Object in your app, as required.

note.p: If Fields for one of the Objects in your app have been previously added, you can click the hyperlink under the "Fields" column to add or remove more Fields.
